description: DNS protocol deep-dive: query rates, domain analysis, registered domains, TLD distribution, latency, query types, response codes, direction, and raw query log.

panels.title: Total Events
panels.description:
Total DNS events captured. Includes both queries (no response seen) and answers (full round-trip).
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: Unique Domains
panels.description:
Cardinality of dns.question.name. High unique domain counts may indicate DGA malware or CDN usage.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: DNS Servers Used
panels.description:
Cardinality of destination.ip for DNS traffic. Should match expected resolver count.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: NXDOMAIN Count
panels.description:
Queries returning NXDOMAIN (non-existent domain). High counts may indicate misconfiguration or malware domain probing.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: DNS Answers
panels.description:
Count of DNS events with dns.type:answer — queries where a response was captured. Compare to Total Events for unanswered query rate.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: Avg Latency
panels.description:
Average round-trip time (event.duration) for answered DNS queries. High latency may indicate resolver issues or DNS tunneling.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: DNS Queries Over Time
panels.description:
DNS event rate per interval. Baseline varies by workload.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: Queries by Domain
panels.description:
Top queried domains over time. Identifies most frequently resolved names.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: Registered Domains
panels.description:
Top registered domains (dns.question.registered_domain). Aggregates subdomains to reveal actual services contacted.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: TLD Distribution
panels.description:
Top-level domain distribution. Unusual TLDs (.xyz, .top) may indicate DGA or phishing domains.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: Query Types
panels.description:
DNS query types (A, AAAA, PTR, MX, etc.) over time. Unexpected types may warrant investigation.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: Response Codes
panels.description:
DNS response codes over time. NOERROR is healthy; NXDOMAIN, SERVFAIL, REFUSED indicate issues.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: DNS Latency Over Time
panels.description:
Average DNS round-trip latency over time (only for answered queries). Spikes indicate resolver congestion.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: Answer TTL Distribution
panels.description:
Average TTL of DNS answers per domain. Low TTLs indicate fast-flux or CDN; anomalous TTLs flag tunneling.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: DNS Type (Query/Answer)
panels.description:
Split by dns.type: "query" (no response captured) vs "answer" (full round-trip). High query:answer ratio = unanswered queries.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: Traffic Direction
panels.description:
DNS traffic direction (egress/ingress). All DNS traffic from our hosts is expected to be egress.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: Answers Count Distribution
panels.description:
Average number of answer records per DNS response. Zero-answer responses may indicate DNS blocking.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns

panels.title: DNS Query Log
panels.description:
Raw DNS events with question name, registered domain, type, response code, answers, direction, latency, and answer count.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.dns
